subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should iOS permanently remove the standalone Talk destination and make Chat the sole conversational surface, with legacy `talk` and `voice` launch aliases opening Chat?
rationale: This is a deliberate user-facing navigation and upgrade contract, not a mechanical correctness question that automated review can settle.

options.title: Approve unified Chat
options.body: Accept Chat as the single iOS conversational destination and retain the alias rerouting plus unified session-ownership model.

options.title: Retain a separate Talk destination
options.body: Keep Talk as a distinct root destination and narrow the PR to shared ownership and presentation improvements that do not change navigation.

options.title: Split the direction
options.body: Approve the underlying ownership work separately while deferring the tab-removal and launch-alias policy to a smaller reviewed change.

recommendation.title: Approve unified Chat
recommendation.body: Accept Chat as the single iOS conversational destination and retain the alias rerouting plus unified session-ownership model.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review routed the iOS navigation-contract decision to an iOS owner and included this person in that review context.
